aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Snapdeal implementation — Commission Invoice Validation vs Settlement
filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where runtime supplies it.
formula_sql:
SELECT
  c.invoice_number,
  c.sub_order_no,
  c.total_commission_amount AS commission_invoice_amt,
  s.commission AS settlement_commission,
  c.total_commission_amount - s.commission AS variance
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
  ON c.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE c.is_active = true;
